KHUSHBU MEHRA

Fund Accounting | NAV | Trade Processing & Settlement | Reconciliation

Pune, India  |  +91-7980022046  |  Khushbumehra23598@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Fund Accounting and Market Operations professional with 4+ years of experience across Hedge Funds, Mutual Funds and Funds. Hands-on experience in NAV production, fund valuation, trade processing and settlement, cash/position reconciliation, corporate actions, fee reporting and financial reporting. Experienced with Bloomberg, Reuters, Multi fonds, TLM/Smart Stream, Aladdin, Frontier and SimCorp Dimension, supporting accurate and timely fund operations within defined controls and SLAs.

CORE SKILLS

Fund Accounting: NAV Calculation, GAV/NAV Valuation, Fund Valuation, Financial Reporting, Fee Calculation, Investor Allocation Sheets

Trade Operations: Trade Processing, Trade Validation, Trade Settlement, Trade Reconciliation, Settlement Exception Management, Trade Break Investigation

Reconciliation: Cash, Position, Market Value, Stock, FX and Nostro Reconciliation; Break Investigation and Resolution

Capital Markets Products: Equities, Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Forwards and CFDs

Corporate Actions: Corporate Action Research and Validation

Tools & Platforms: Multi fonds, TLM/SmartStream, Bloomberg, Reuters, Aladdin, Frontier, SimCorp Dimension, Excel

Controls & Reporting: SOP Documentation, UAT Testing, Process Improvement, Risk/KPI Reporting, Management Fee Reporting, SLA Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Formidium India Pvt. Ltd., Pune

Associate Manager – Fund Accounting Operations  |  Jul 2024 – Aug 2025

Managed hedge fund accounting and financial reporting activities for a diversified client portfolio, including cryptocurrency funds.

Performed portfolio valuation, accounting and risk reporting activities within defined SLA and control requirements.

Performed security pricing and validation using Bloomberg, Reuters, CRB and NYSE data sources.

Reviewed broker and investment manager trade postings investigated discrepancies and supported timely resolution of trade-related breaks.

Processed and validated trade settlements across Equities, Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Forwards and CFDs, ensuring accurate and timely settlements.

Monitored settlement status, investigated settlement discrepancies and coordinated with brokers/custodians for timely exception resolution.

Performed post-trade reconciliation of settled trades against broker and fund records, validating cash, position and NAV impact.

Managed cash reconciliation activities for a major custodian supporting a platinum client with reported AUM of £500bn.

Prepared and delivered client reports while coordinating with upstream/downstream teams to resolve operational queries.

Supported process improvement and efficiency initiatives across fund accounting operations.

Citicorp Services India Private Limited, Gurgaon

Fund Accounting Specialist – EMEA/NAM/APAC  |  Sep 2023 – Jun 2024

Performed daily NAV calculation and valuation for traditional funds using the Multifonds accounting platform.

Validated security pricing using Bloomberg Terminal and researched corporate actions and security information.

Performed cash, position and holding reconciliations, investigating and resolving breaks within defined timelines.

Validated trade activity and investigated trade-related reconciliation breaks to ensure accurate reflection of transactions in NAV and fund accounting records.

Prepared and maintained SOPs for live and migrated funds, supporting consistent valuation and operational controls.

Prepared Risk, KPI and Management Fee reports for client and management review.

Ensured accurate NAV calculation and valuation within prescribed control procedures and SLA requirements.

Prepared financial statements including Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Investment Portfolio and Investor Allocation Sheets.

Participated in client and onshore calls to resolve operational queries and valuation-related issues.

Deutsche Bank (DBOI Global Services Pvt. Ltd.) / DWS, Bangalore

Reconciliation Production Operator – EMEA  |  May 2021 – Aug 2023

Performed reconciliation between DWS books and custodian records across Stock, Cash, FX and Corporate Actions.

Managed Cash, Suspense Account, Asset/Stock, FX and Nostro reconciliations.

Investigated and resolved complex reconciliation breaks within defined SLA timelines.

Performed timely escalation of aged and critical breaks to relevant stakeholders.

Coordinated with custodians and internal teams to investigate discrepancies and drive resolution.

Supported process improvement and best-practice initiatives to improve processing efficiency and reduce SLA breaches.

Managed high-volume reconciliation activities while maintaining accuracy and timely delivery.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Star Award – June 2022, DWS

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATION

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com Hons.) – Shri Shikshayatan College, Calcutta University | 2020

Company Secretary – Pursuing Intermediate – ICSI

LANGUAGES

English | Hindi | Punjabi | Bengali

Khushbu Mehra
